# Build Your Own AI Bot (RAG for non-technical people) — delivery kit

*Business users, analysts, project owners · 22 hours · level 2 · certification: practitioner*

| What | Where | Edit it |
|---|---|---|
| Slides | `slides/slides.md` | edit, then `python scripts/build_slides.py` |
| Working demos (4) — offline; richer with an LLM key | `demos/NN_*.py`, `demos/run_all.py` | plain Python on the shared toolkit `training-materials/labkit/` |
| Trainer's run sheet | `facilitator-guide.md` | regenerate, or delete the marker line and edit by hand |
| Exercise sheets | `exercises.md` | same |
| Handout | `handouts/01_key_ideas.md` | same |

## You will be able to

- Build a working bot from your own documents without code
- Diagnose why a bot is wrong and fix it
- Know which settings to change and what they do
- Estimate running cost
- Know what to ask an engineer for

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_bot_from_one_document.py` | 1 | 15 | closed-book guess vs grounded answer with a citation vs honest refusal, on one policy document |
| 2 | `02_build_the_library.py` | 2 | 20 | a document folder audited for drafts and duplicates, chunked two ways, given a contextual prefix and permission labels — and what a restricted user can no longer see |
| 3 | `03_find_the_right_page.py` | 3 | 20 | retrieval recall on a test sheet as you add query rewriting, hybrid search, reranking and change top-k — one change per run |
| 4 | `04_answer_well_go_live.py` | 4 | 20 | the grounding instruction in action, a full test-sheet score including refusals, the monthly cost at your volume and a go/no-go launch checklist |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
